## Professional Background
Moses Thomas (Moses Naantagam Thomas) holds a B.Tech in Mathematics (Industrial Mathematics and Statistics) from the Federal University of Technology. He combines rigorous algorithmic analysis with senior full-stack development experience across TypeScript, React 19, Next.js, Python, PostgreSQL, and modern cloud platforms.

## Core Technical Competencies
- **Web & Full Stack**: TypeScript, JavaScript (ESNext), Next.js, React 19, TanStack Start, Node.js, Tailwind CSS (v3 & v4), REST, GraphQL.
- **AI & RAG Systems**: Google Gemini API, OpenAI API, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Supabase Vector, pgvector, Firecrawl, autonomous tool-use agents.
- **Database & Cloud**: PostgreSQL, Neon Serverless, PGLite (WASM), Kysely, Prisma, Docker, Vercel, AWS, Cloudflare, CI/CD automation.
- **Data Science**: Python, pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, statistical modeling, predictive classification, Power BI, advanced SQL analytics.

## Flagship Production Case Studies
- [Agatha Career Intelligence](https://xheen.tech/projects/agatha-career-intelligence): AI-powered career automation platform running at https://agathalabs.app. Parses unstructured resumes, matches live opportunities, tailors ATS documents, and executes automated job applications.
- [SupportIQ](https://xheen.tech/projects/supportiq): Autonomous customer support system utilizing Gemini LLM and Firecrawl + Supabase vector embeddings for citation-grounded RAG query answering.
- [Velo E-Commerce](https://xheen.tech/projects/velo-e-commerce): High-speed headless e-commerce storefront powered by Next.js, Sanity.io CMS, and Tailwind CSS.
- [Secure Web](https://xheen.tech/projects/secure-web): Real-time security telemetry dashboard built with high-performance CSS animations and dynamic SVG data flows.
- [Gymzest Platform](https://xheen.tech/projects/gymzest): High-converting membership and subscription platform with tiered service catalog and digital onboarding.
